title: Run-scoped approval grants
description: Written only by the host launcher, and only in response to `dca run --approve <request-id>`, the single trusted approval channel in V1 (FR-027a), after verifying provenance against the authoritative host copy of the originating report. V1 accepts no manually authored grant files as input. Valid only for the NEW run named in run_id (FR-027b). Never covers DENY classes. The host copy is authoritative; the in-VM copy (/run/dca/grants.json) only feeds the cooperative gate and is never read back as evidence. Every provenance value is computed from host-side data (host report file, host git, CLI input); repository content and in-VM state cannot produce it.

run_id.description: the NEW run these launcher-generated grants belong to

granted_by.description: only the launcher CLI channel is a trusted approval channel in V1

request_id.description: id from the originating report's approvals list

action_class.description: must equal the originating request's class; DENY classes (data-model Action Classes) are never grantable

exact.description: normalized action + target; must equal the originating request's normalized_target

equivalence_class.description: must equal the originating request's declared equivalence class

network_destinations.description: named hosts the launcher adds to this run's host-side sbx policy (untrusted network grants)

provenance.description: binds the grant to the request that produced it; verified by the launcher before the grant is created (data-model ApprovalGrant). Any mismatch = stale approval, launcher exits 3.

origin_report_digest.description: digest of the host copy of the originating report.json

task_fingerprint.description: must equal both the originating report's and the new run's task_fingerprint

source_commit.description: must equal both the originating and the new run's source commit

origin_backend.description: must equal the new run's backend

origin_trust_level.description: must equal the new run's trust level
